articles.source_title: Kristaps Porzingis to Celtics, Marcus Smart to Grizzlies in 3-team deal
articles.source_excerpt: Marcus Smart heads to Memphis while Tyus Jones and the 25th pick, Marcus Sasser, move out in the three-team deal.

events.raw_note: Kristaps Porzingis, Marcus Smart and Tyus Jones headline the blockbuster trade between the Celtics, Wizards and Grizzlies. As part of the deal, the Grizzlies receive Marcus Smart and send Tyus Jones and the draft rights to Marcus Sasser out.

articles.source_title: Dillon Brooks lands 4-year deal with Rockets in sign-and-trade
articles.source_excerpt: Brooks joined Houston in a sign-and-trade that sent Josh Christopher to Memphis and also involved draft-rights movement.

events.label: Memphis sends Dillon Brooks to Houston in multi-team sign-and-trade
events.raw_note: Brooks joined Houston via a five-team sign-and-trade deal. Houston dealt Josh Christopher to Memphis, and Vanja Marinkovic's draft rights moved to the Grizzlies in the transaction cluster.

articles.source_title: Brooklyn Nets complete three-team trade with Phoenix and Memphis

events.label: Memphis completes three-team trade with Phoenix and Brooklyn
events.raw_note: The Suns acquired David Roddy from the Memphis Grizzlies in exchange for Chimezie Metu and Yuta Watanabe. To complete the deal, Brooklyn acquired the draft rights to Vanja Marinkovic from Memphis.
